import { Component } from '@angular/core'; interface BlogItem { image: string; title: string; author: string; date: string; description: string; } @Component({ selector: 'app-blog-carousel', templateUrl: './blog-carousel.component.html', styleUrls: ['./blog-carousel.component.css'] }) export class BlogCarouselComponent { currentIndex = 0; items: BlogItem[] = [ { image: 'https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2019/03/10/18/31/hong-kong-4046913_960_720.jpg', title: 'We are best for any industrial & business solution.', author: 'Alexa', date: 'August 1, 2020', description: 'Lorem Ipsum is simply dummy text of the printing and typesetting industry. Lorem...' }, { image: 'https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2015/07/09/22/45/tree-838667_960_720.jpg', title: 'We are best for any industrial & business solution.', author: 'Alexa', date: 'August 1, 2020', description: 'Lorem Ipsum is simply dummy text of the printing and typesetting industry. Lorem...' }, { image: 'https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2016/11/29/03/53/adult-1868750_960_720.jpg', title: 'Industrial solutions for modern companies.', author: 'John', date: 'August 2, 2020', description: 'Lorem Ipsum is simply dummy text of the printing and typesetting industry. Lorem...' } ]; get visibleItems(): BlogItem[] { const duplicated = [...this.items, ...this.items]; return duplicated.slice(this.currentIndex, this.currentIndex + 3); } next(): void { this.currentIndex++; if (this.currentIndex >= this.items.length) { this.currentIndex = 0; } } prev(): void { this.currentIndex--; if (this.currentIndex < 0) { this.currentIndex = this.items.length - 1; } } }
